summary.text: King of Halicarnassus and father of Artemisia, the queen who of her own will sailed with Xerxes against Greece and won renown at Salamis.

story.text: At Delphi, among white-marble figures of Persians on the pillars, Pausanias saw a statue of Artemisia daughter of Lygdamis and queen of Halicarnassus — a lady who voluntarily joined Xerxes' expedition and distinguished herself at the naval battle off Salamis. The father is named only as king of her Carian city.
